QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] A Formidable Opponent
QuestInfo.0: What will your next challenge be? Talk to Eremos.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you are approaching level 100, Eremos suggests a new challenge. He suggests you defeat Zakum, a singularly evil entity. He says it's the final step toward earning a new power, but he seems more interested in the Zakum fragment than your own success.
QuestInfo.2: Eremos seems incredibly pleased that you were able to obtain the fragment from Zakum.
